title: Lemon Caper Cream Sauce
description: A thick, glossy lemon caper sauce built to cling to mahi-mahi, chicken, or pasta, with plenty extra for spooning.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: to taste, go light because capers are salty

steps.title: Prepare the citrus
steps.text: Measure {zest} and {lemon} separately. Keep {capers}, {brine} and {parsley} chilled for serving.

steps.title: Bloom the garlic
steps.text: Melt {butter} in a HexClad skillet over medium-low heat. Add {garlic} and stir for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Toast the roux
steps.text: Whisk in {flour} and cook for 1 minute.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.text: Gradually whisk in {broth} then {cream}. Stir in {umami} and {zest}. Gently simmer for 4–5 minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Finish the base
steps.text: Whisk in {butterfin} off the heat. Separate portions for storage before the finishing ingredients are added.

steps.title: Finish each serving
steps.text: Dress only the sauce being served with its share of {lemon}, rinsed {capers}, {brine} and {parsley}. Taste before adding {salt} or {pepper}.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the base and chill promptly in shallow containers for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, with some possible dairy separation. Freeze only the plain base for up to 1 month. Fridge reheat: whisk over low heat to 165°F, thinning with a little milk. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge; reheat as above. Add capers, brine, lemon and parsley only to the portions being served after reheating. Option A uses the listed finish. Gentler Option B: omit the brine and halve the lemon juice. Dairy swap: use unsalted plant butter and unsweetened oat cream. Sodium includes all the measured capers and brine; a 4% salt brine is assumed, and jar brands vary. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 390 kcal, 3.8 g protein, 8.8 g total carbohydrate, 39.0 g fat, 0.9 g fiber, 525 mg sodium. Based on the measured ingredients; brands and optional additions can change these values.
